2124245138507735470.en_summary: A Financial Times investigation has uncovered an extensive network allegedly moving billions of dollars in Nvidia ($NVDA) AI chips into China through Southeast Asia, linking former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to Chinese gaming companies, offshore entities and individuals associated with an alleged Cambodian criminal syndicate. The findings deepen scrutiny of Nvidia's export controls.
2124245138507735470.zh_summary: 金融時報調查揭露一個廣泛網絡，據稱透過東南亞將數十億美元的 Nvidia（$NVDA）AI 晶片運入中國，將前 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 與中國遊戲公司、離岸實體以及與據稱柬埔寨犯罪集團相關的個人聯繫起來。這些發現加深了對 Nvidia 出口管制的審查。

2124243699613708581.en_summary: $SPCX: SpaceX appears to be merging Cursor's command-line tool with Grok Build. A developer found that Cursor CLI build downloads a Grok Build 2.0 prerelease from a new "unified" channel. It offers Cursor or Grok sign-in and 38 models, including Grok, Composer, Claude and Gemini. Neither company has announced it yet.
2124243699613708581.zh_summary: $SPCX：SpaceX 似乎正在將 Cursor 的命令列工具與 Grok Build 合併。一名開發者發現 Cursor CLI build 從新的「統一」頻道下載 Grok Build 2.0 預發布版。它提供 Cursor 或 Grok 登入以及 38 個模型，包括 Grok、Composer、Claude 和 Gemini。兩家公司都尚未宣布。
